description: A man in a long dark coat with a high collar, seen in profile, holds an open book up in one hand toward a pale glowing light. The oil painting is a square canvas sitting on a pale grey wall with the wall visible on all four sides and a soft edge shadow. A tiny sparkle logo sits in the bottom-right corner. No readable text, nothing gory.
